And he plays, he loves vocals, you know, but he does play Bill Ev… uh, Tony Bennett and Bill Evans, those things, and he plays some unusual … and he plays Os…, he loves Oscar Peterson. That's his favorite, seems to be his favorite jazz pianist. Had the pleasure of meeting him the other night and he uh was at an…
Is it … are you at a point now where uh, you've heard so much music, you've played so much music that you pretty much don't need to um, where silence is of value to you?
